scripts.text: Will you assist your comrades by gathering monsters to follow you?

scripts.text: That is not acceptable. Purposely taunting monsters to follow you can be very dangerous and harmful to others. This is not the way of a monk.
scripts.translation: 這可不行。故意挑釁魔物，讓它們跟隨自己，既危險，又可能危害他人。這不是武僧之道。

scripts.text: ... that behavior is regarded as careless and is not tolerated.
scripts.translation: ...這種行為太過魯莽，我們絕不容許。

scripts.text: Even though you may be nearly invincible when hardening your body that skill is meant to be used for emergency situation not to be used for such disrespectful use!
scripts.translation: 即使你能讓身體變得堅不可摧，近乎無敵，那項技能也是用來應對危急情況的，絕不能用於這種無禮之舉！

scripts.text: You might feel that's helping others, but it's not true.
scripts.translation: 你也許覺得這是在幫助別人，其實不然。再

scripts.text: Consider what it is you must do as a monk for others again.
scripts.translation: 好好想想，身為武僧，你究竟該為他人做些什麼。

scripts.text: Will you yell and shout the same things over and over again in towns or in fields?

scripts.text: You are not allowed to do so. This doesn't apply only to monks but to everyone.
scripts.translation: 不許這樣做。這不只是武僧的規矩，每個人都該遵守。

scripts.text: Even if you mean well by it, it is disrespectful and not allowed.
scripts.translation: 即使你出於好意，這也是無禮之舉，絕不容許。

scripts.text: Are you willing to die for others on your monk's path of being a holy executioner?
scripts.translation: 作為武僧，你將踏上神聖行刑者之路，你願意為他人獻出生命嗎？

scripts.text: You cannot become a monk with such an attitude!!!

scripts.text: If we can eliminate at least one more enemy of ours by sacrificing ourselves, that's what is expected of you as a holy executioner in whom we are trained to be.
scripts.translation: ！！！哪怕犧牲自己只能多消滅一個敵人，也該挺身而出，這正是我們修行成為神聖行刑者後應盡的職責。

scripts.text: If you are unwilling to sacrifice yourself for those you care about,

scripts.text: Picking the mushrooms is to train your tolerance.

scripts.text: We planted a garden in order to survive as well as to discipline our minds.
scripts.translation: 我們開闢菜園，既是為了生存，也是為了磨練心智。

scripts.text: I believe there is no better way to find true inner peace then to be one with nature.
scripts.translation: 我相信，與自然合一，是尋得內心真正安寧的最佳途徑。

scripts.text: So we created our garden, however these mushrooms started sprouting up everywhere!
scripts.translation: 所以我們開闢了菜園，可這些蘑菇卻到處冒了出來！

scripts.text: What we ask of you as part of your training is to remove these mushrooms.

scripts.text: While you're wandering around within the maze, if you encounter any evil creatures, just kill them! Release their tortured souls!!
scripts.translation: 在迷宮裡探索時，遇到邪惡的生物就殺掉它們！讓它們飽受折磨的靈魂得到解脫！！

scripts.text: Do not compare us to the weakling priests! We are monks and we will always be the strongest!!
scripts.translation: 別把我們和那些軟弱的牧師相提並論！我們是武僧，我們將永遠是最強的！！

scripts.text: We are not like priests who cower behind the strength of others!
scripts.translation: 我們不像那些牧師，畏畏縮縮地躲在別人身後，依靠別人的力量！

scripts.text: Now, focus!! Keep your fists tight and your eyes open! It's time to show me what you got.
scripts.translation: 集中精神！！握緊拳頭，睜大眼睛！是時候讓我看看你的實力了。

scripts.text: Let's see if you got what it takes to be a true monk!!
scripts.translation: 讓我看看你有沒有成為真正武僧的本事！！

scripts.text: Cheer up! Failure is but a process to success!

scripts.text: Go! Start again! Kill them all!!
I knew you'd make it through!
Now...I will give you a secret potion which will double your physical strength.

scripts.text: Drink this potion and you will be able to become a monk!!!
